|rulings=* Works with substituted draws (e.g. a destiny value obtained from [[Smoke Screen]] would count as Light's draw).<ref name="scomp" />
* Modifiers to individual battle destiny draws are applied before comparing them to see which is higher.
* Compare the battle destinies as an automatic action just after both players have finished drawing (or substituting) their one battle destiny.
* Resets opponent's ''total'' battle destiny to an unmodifiable 0.
* Works with [[I Don't Like Sand]] - limits both players to 1 battle destiny draw, then is able to reduce opponent's ''total'' to 0 (the individual draw may not be modified, but the total may be modified).
|combos=* [[Smoke Screen]] - Easily get a high destiny, reducing opponent's total to 0.<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Kal%27Falnl%20C%27ndros</ref>
* [[I Don't Like Sand]] - Cause both players to draw only one battle destiny, setting up KFC. KFC's text does work with Sand, reducing opponent's total to 0.
